name: LumenWEB

description: Easily set up websites using LumenWEB.

variables.name: Website Domain
variables.description: Your website's domain name. Ensure a CNAME record points to web.lumenvm.cloud. You can put multiple domains separated by a comma. Make sure you enable this in the domain mode variable.

variables.name: Website root
variables.description: The webroot directory for your website. This must be in /home/container/.

variables.name: Webserver Software
variables.description: Select the software to run your web server.

variables.name: Java Version
variables.description: Select the JDK version to use (21 or 25). Can be used with custom commands or when SOFTWARE is set to java.

variables.name: JAR File
variables.description: The name of the JAR file to execute inside your webroot.

variables.name: Java Arguments
variables.description: Additional JVM arguments to pass when starting Java (e.g. -Xms128M -Xmx512M).

variables.name: Custom command
variables.description: Enter the custom command to run. This will automatically overwrite the SOFTWARE variable.

variables.name: Overwrite IP
variables.description: This allows admins to overwrite the IP address shown in different scenarios. Useful when running behind a tunnel/proxy.

variables.name: Overwrite BANNER
variables.description: This allows admin to change the banner shown when starting up. Use \n for newlines.
